chunks: And from a letter from him (peace be upon him) to him also.
ai.seo_question: What is the title of Imam Ali's letter to Mu'awiya in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a seminal diplomatic correspondence from Imam Ali (AS) to Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, capturing the essence of their political and theological rivalry during the First Fitna. It sets the stage for Ali's arguments regarding the legitimacy of his caliphate and the deviations of the Umayyads, reflecting the broader Shia perspective on leadership (Imamate) and justice.
